run_grpc_eval_server: run a gRPC server on port 8085 for real-world robot pick and place evaluation
run_eval_with_test_pick: run the evaluation server with test pick mode enabled for grasping tests
run_eval_with_dry_run: run the evaluation server in dry run mode without executing real robot actions
run_eval_with_visualize_maps: run the evaluation server with map visualization enabled for debugging navigation
run_eval_with_reset_nav: run the evaluation server and reset the robot navigation to origin position
